sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - AS VAL is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've got a new order and no way to complete it myself. Help me out, and I'll share part of the reward with you. Build me an AS VAL with a GL-SHOCK stock, AN/PEQ-15 laser, NSPU-M night scope, and a 30-round magazine. Ergonomics at or above 27 and combined recoil below 220. Come back when it's finished."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an AS VAL to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Tech manual
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SOPMOD I) at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle (variant SAI) at Ref LL3
"You brought the rifle? Excellent. Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
AS VAL specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 27 or more ergonomics
- 220 or less recoil
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 30
- AR-15 FAB Defense GL-SHOCK buttstock
- L3Harris AN/PEQ-15 tactical device (Tan)
- NSPU-M 3.5x dovetail night vision scope

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard AS VAL from Prapor LL4.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
